title: Natural total tensor pullback comparison with summand normalization
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y, commutative ring sheaves R and R′ on their pro-etale sites in universe u+1, and c:f⁻¹R≅R′, write L for the identified module pullback. Let ν:tensor_Y⋙L≅(L×L)⋙tensor_X have the prescribed ordinary tensor-pullback components. There exists a natural total comparison e:T′(L−,L−)≅L(T(−,−)) whose inverse components are the prescribed pointwise total comparisons, and for every pair P,Q and homogeneous total summand p+q=k, L(ι_{p,q});(e⁻¹(P,Q))^k = ν(P^p,Q^q);ι′_{p,q}. No associativity, flatness or derived-category hypothesis is used.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 07A4 and 06YN: natural pullback tensor comparisons and signed total tensor summands.

proof.text: Take the existing natural total comparison with its component normalization. For an arbitrary homogeneous summand, rewrite the total component and the ordinary natural component by their normalizations. The existing geometric total-coproduct summand identity gives exactly the asserted equation. Retain both the pointwise and summand formulas with that same natural comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleTotalTensorPullbackComparisonNormalization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ R')
    (ν : @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R) ⋙
        proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c ≅
      ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c).prod
        (proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c)) ⋙
        @MonoidalCategory.tensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R'))
    (hμ : ∀ M N, ν.hom.app (M, N) =
      (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f R R' c M N).hom)
 :
    let L := proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c
    ∃ e : (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
        coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology X) R' ≅
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology Y) R ⋙
        (proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      (∀ P Q, e.inv.app (P, Q) = (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R R' c P Q).inv) ∧
    ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ)
      (p q k : ℤ) (h : p + q = k),
      L.map (RingedForgetTensorTransposition.coefficientTensorSummand.{u + 1, u, u}
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R P Q p q k h) ≫
          (e.inv.app (P, Q)).f k =
        ν.hom.app (P.X p, Q.X q) ≫
          RingedForgetTensorTransposition.coefficientTensorSummand.{u + 1, u, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) R' ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
              ((L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q k h
